phase: 37 — apply the proven QA scope fix (QA ENGINE ONLY)

additions.what: isDecorativeMcqSpan(n) + decorativeIdx map, built AFTER the node list is finalised
additions.code: function isDecorativeMcqSpan(n){ return !!(n && n.closest && n.closest('button.mcq-option')); } var decorativeIdx={}; nodes.forEach(function(n,i){ if(isDecorativeMcqSpan(n)) decorativeIdx[i]=true; });
additions.note: node SELECTION is untouched — nodes keep their original positions, so every occurrence index is preserved

additions.code: var suppressed = findings.filter(function(f){ return f.index>=0 && decorativeIdx[f.index]; }); findings = findings.filter(function(f){ return !(f.index>=0 && decorativeIdx[f.index]); });
additions.note: index>=0 guard keeps chapter-level findings (LETTER_ROLE_UNSTABLE, index -1) untouched
additive only; occurrences/checked/findings/counts/clean keep their existing meaning
